facts.text: The Chapman Scholars Program awards six incoming freshmen full tuition and class fee credit for up to 18 credit hours per semester, on-campus housing, textbooks, and a food stipend for four years.

sources.title: Chapman Scholars | Purdue University Fort Wayne
sources.quote: Chapman Scholars receive tuition and class fee credit for a maximum of 18 credit hours, on-campus housing, textbooks, and a stipend for food each eligible fall and spring semester per aid year.
